WITH state_base AS (
  SELECT c.state_county_province AS state,
         COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
  FROM Customers c
  LEFT JOIN Accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.state_county_province
),
shares AS (
  SELECT state, account_count,
         1.0 * account_count / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(account_count) FROM state_base), 0) AS share
  FROM state_base
),
avg_tbl AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(s.account_count) AS combined_account_base,
       AVG(s.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(s.share - t.avg_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN avg_tbl t
WHERE s.share > t.avg_share;
